text_0271616ea58c: Three navigation concepts for desktop and mobile. Previews do not change the current menu.
text_0296ac1b90a8: Desktop: compact menu above the workspace. Mobile: the same structure with large buttons.
text_0cce83e9df81: Desktop: section bar at the top. Mobile: main sections at the bottom, other modules as tiles.
text_1a6e3a02ee5e: Quick access on phones with only a few main sections.
text_2fbc0f8fcf3b: Your choice is saved in your account and can be changed at any time.
text_7b0c82b9ed2b: Useful for frequent switching between many modules.
text_a120cd8e8d19: Desktop: sections remain visible on the left. Mobile: open and close the menu with a button.
text_c3cdbe324e2d: Plenty of room for wide planning and data tables.
